changelog: Fix calendar events and to-dos disappearing after wipe-and-fresh-sync. The orphan-reconciliation pass in useCalendarEvents/useTodoItems was tombstoning items mid-sync (and pushing those tombstones back to Drive) because the parallelized sharded sync downloads events/todos before the bulkier memory files. Reconciliation now waits for sync to drain so a not-yet-arrived memory isn't mistaken for a deleted one.
